summary: Your web app moves to its standard name without breaking bookmarks.

fixes.title: Web app moves to its standard name
fixes.text: A new web app is created beside the old one and checked. The old address then forwards every page, and is removed only after someone signs in on the new one.

fixes.title: Custom addresses are never moved silently
fixes.text: An installation with a custom domain or a custom public address stops before the move and tells you so.

fixes.title: Sign-in stays set up across updates
fixes.text: SecurityInsight keeps its own sign-in set up across updates.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Database setup now records which Invardia Support app your installation trusts.
